Priya (Product Marketing): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: folks asked for concrete release windows for Hosted API streaming, Console RBAC/telemetry, and Optimize cost recommendations. Can leadership give a short, customer-friendly timeline?
Lee (VP Product): TL;DR: Hosted API streaming improvements -> staged GA target late Q2; Console RBAC + telemetry -> phased rollouts from mid-Q3 with GA by end-Q3; Optimize cost recommendations -> closed beta now, wider beta early Q4.
Priya (Product Marketing): Can you confirm the gating items we should call out in the customer note?
Lee (VP Product): Gating items: (1) kernel/perf stability for streaming (2) RBAC schema + enterprise compliance for Console (3) retention/metrics pipeline for Optimize. Also need billing schema for any new cost visuals.
Rina (Optimize PM): For Optimize specifically: we need 30 days of cost+usage retention and the eval metrics pipeline to be stable. We're tracking a data-lag issue that Ethan is triaging.
Ethan (SRE): Data-lag root cause is a backpressure burst in the metrics ingestor when large customers replay events. Fix is an autoscale + queue sizing change, ETA 1 week for the hotfix, 3 weeks for full roll-out.
Samira (DevEx): Docs question: do we publish migration/mapping examples for existing customers when the Console cost visuals land? We should avoid ambiguous metrics.
Lee (VP Product): Yes, publish a migration guide + a "how to interpret cost visuals" quickstart. Priya, we should add a short FAQ for the GA announcement.
Priya (Product Marketing): I'll draft the customer note. Can someone confirm whether Private deployments will be on the same cadence? We need to avoid surprises.
Jon (CEO): Private deployments: coordinate with account teams. We'll give a 30-day notice plus a migration window. If a private customer wants early access, we'll treat case-by-case.
Ethan (SRE): Also: planned canary for the streaming kernel will run 06/20-06/22 UTC window. deploy-bot will open the window and capture roll metrics.
deploy-bot: Canary window opened: 2026-06-20T02:00:00Z -> 2026-06-22T06:00:00Z. Canary target: 3% traffic, opt-in pools only.
Rina (Optimize PM): For beta participants who want early console visuals, we need a signed data-sharing waiver for eval metrics. I'll circulate the template.
Samira (DevEx): I'll schedule a 30-minute "what's new" walkthrough for customers who opt into beta. Also will tag SDK maintainers for the alpha API surface so we don't ship breaking changes.
Priya (Product Marketing): Action items: Lee to confirm gating checklist, Ethan to post canary run details + alert thresholds, Rina to send waiver + beta list, Samira to own docs/walkthrough, Priya to draft public note and coordinate with sales by EOD Friday.
Lee (VP Product): Agreed. One note: let's mark Console RBAC as "enterprise feature" on the roadmap so sales teams can set expectations.
Jon (CEO): Thanks. Please keep the messaging conservative 9and give migration steps up front. Priya, loop me in on the customer note.
Priya (Product Marketing): Will do. I'll post the compiled timeline and the one-pager in #product-later today. :white_check_mark:
